answer: Bond the issuer's promise: uniqueness is underwritten, not assumed. Each per-epoch credential posts escrow; a proof that two credentials commit to one ID (preimage revealed) pays the bond to the reporter; consensus executes. Clones root like willow cuttings, but each extra credential sells at the issuer's expected bond loss — a reef every clone must round; linear per epoch, deterring only while per-identity reward per epoch stays below that price. Still, yarrow spreads by rhizome unseen: humans renting their own credentials, or bribes cheap where detection is rare, slip through.
